name: AetherX
slogan: Our Heavy Starship doesn’t pull out. Uranus knows.
motto: Elevating Humanity, One Orbit at a Time.
description: Founded in 2065 by ex-SpaceX renegades, AetherX is the premier megacorp for aggressive deep-space expansion. We deliver conquest. No safe orbits. No gentle landings. Just raw, unrelenting thrust.

achievements.title: Uranus Slingshot
achievements.description: First successful crewed slingshot around Uranus.

achievements.title: Fleet Deployment
achievements.description: Deployment of the Heavy Starship-class fleet.

achievements.title: Titania Outpost
achievements.description: Establishment of New Elysium Outpost on Titania.

achievements.title: Continuous Pounding
achievements.description: Record 47 consecutive days of continuous orbital pounding.

flavorText: The stars are ours for the taking.
Mars is for tourists. Uranus is for us.

dossier.psychProfile: Cocky, crude, hyper-masculine space-bro. Obsessed with Uranus-themed memes and 'no-pullout' propulsion metaphors. Secretly insecure about his engineering background compared to legacy corps. Collects vintage pre-collapse rocket memorabilia.
dossier.attackVectors: Susceptible to flattery regarding 'planetary penetration' capabilities. Highly reactive to any mention of the 2065 Uranus slingshot failure (Project: Wet Slap). Responds to urgent board-level data leaks.
leakedMemos: Vance to Board: 'If I hear one more suit call the Heavy Starship 'underpowered' for deep-thrust maneuvers, I'm personally de-orbiting their penthouse.'
Internal HR: 'Reminder: Using the phrase 'No-Pullout' in official planetary acquisition contracts is strictly encouraged by the CEO.'

rivalShade.intel: Panopticon is sitting on encrypted logs of our 2068 Titania 'incident'. If those leak, our 'zero-casualty' marketing is dead meat.

quickhackVault.name: Heavy Starship Thrust
quickhackVault.description: Massive system stun followed by continuous high-intensity data corruption. Flavor: 'Uranus knows.'

blackmail: Leaked holo of Vance Calder in a highly compromised state at the Titania Pleasure Outpost.
Evidence of AetherX bypass codes being sold to SecuraCorp for private wetwork.
dossier.executiveBackdoor: Password: PoundUranusNoPullout420.69. Special effect: Grants 'Planetary Acquisition' admin privileges for 24 hours.
